$comment: Classification of every plugin under resources/plugins/, checked by
Why an explicit list instead of inferring from each manifest: whether a
plugin is ours or vendored from upstream is a distribution decision, not a
property derivable from files. A manifest author field can be edited; the
redistribution obligation cannot. Requiring explicit classification means a
newly added plugin fails the check until someone states which bucket it is
in, so a third-party plugin cannot slip in unrecorded.
firstParty: authored by this project; no third-party license obligation.
thirdParty: vendored from upstream; must keep its license file in-tree and
Anthropic's plugins from anthropics/claude-code must never be added here:
